subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in the
stimulus: parenthesis. 10 Road accidents have (a) recent become a regular phenomenon in our country. As a result of the accidents many persons fall a victim to (b) timely death. It is reported that most of the accidents occur because of the (c) violate of traffic rules by (d) skilled drivers and (e) conscious passersby. Many (f) licensed and (g) fault vehicles run on the streets. These vehicles (h) danger the (i) safe of passengers and the passersby. But many of us are (j) aware of this danger.
guide_solution: (a) recently (b) untimely (c) violation (d) unskilled (e) unconscious (f) unlicensed (g) faulty (h) endanger (i) safety (j) unaware
